neighbours.label: ' on' or ' is' right after a noun for a program or device (program on, plugin on, this method is)
fire: Each app on my phone asks for location access.
The script on the server crashes every night.
This function is called whenever the window resizes.
Any process on a Linux machine has a parent.
The extension on the browser blocks most ads.
This class is used to parse the config file.
Every sensor on the board reports its temperature.
The firmware on the router needs an update.
quiet: My phone asks for location access for every app.
The server crashes every night because of the script.
Whenever the window resizes, we call this function.
A Linux machine gives every process a parent.
The browser blocks most ads with an extension.
We use this class to parse the config file.
The board reports the temperature of every sensor.
The router needs a firmware update soon.

notes: Card: ' on' after program/plugin/devices, ' is' after 'This method'/'This program'. Probe: 'program on a Unix system' 0.80, 'plugin on the forum' 0.57, 'student on the team' 0.03. The - pole is the verb after 'a device that'.
